title: Anatta (1)
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Anattā anattā ti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante anattāti || || 4 Rūpaṃ kho Rādha anattā || vedanā anattā || saññā || saṅkhārā anattā || viññāṇam anattāti || || 5 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
